en: How to Play GO! GO! Kettle Ring{KP}It's a game where you slide a tea kettle, just like curling!{KP}And of course, the numbers written on the ice are your score!{KP}How hard you slide the kettle depends on the gauge on the left!{KP}The higher the gauge, the harder the kettle slides!{KP}But slide it too hard, and the kettle goes through the hole and into the water, ker-splash!{KP}Press the Circle button when the gauge is where you want to throw!{KP}After you throw the kettle, use the brush with the Circle button!{KP}Scrub the ice with the brush to make the kettle go farther!{KP}Your total score from 3 throws decides your level!{KP}Whatever you do, watch out for a splash into the pond!
